text:
maya: Heads up — OrionFin wants to demo tool-calling where the model triggers a webhook into their internal orchestration. Their firewall blocks inbound connections; demo in 24h. Need quick options + cost for a 2-hour dedicated test window.

ravi: common patterns: webhook via customer-facing reverse-proxy we provide, or pollback where model issues a call_id and their service polls our API for results. Which SDK are they using?

maya: Python team on their side. They prefer not to run containers.

zoe: pollback is easiest for them — no inbound ports. Node/Python SDKs include a poll helper. Latency depends on poll interval; for demos use 200-500ms. For higher concurrency recommend Dedicated to avoid throttling.

omar: security checklist: confirm whether payloads include sensitive data (PII/financial). If yes, we need an addendum and to ensure ephemeral tokens + mTLS for callback registration. Also, some proxies strip nonstandard headers so polling is safer.

maya: they asked for numbers: 2 hours, 8 concurrent streams, occasional callbacks.

zoe: quick ballpark: transient Dedicated: 2 GPUs * 2 hours at promo rate ~$4/node-hour => ~$16. Hosted approach usage-based is small for a short demo but less predictable under concurrency.

ravi: I'll provide the pollback snippet and a fallback README for reverse-proxy if they decide to accept a container.

infra-bot: ephemeral-token feature already enabled for org: orionfin-sandbox.

omar: next steps: 1) propose pollback as default; 2) offer reverse-proxy container as backup; 3) send transient Dedicated quote and get PO if they want guaranteed throughput; 4) ask customer whether payloads contain regulated data so we can route legal.

maya: I'll loop them in and send the pollback snippet. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
